2. Applications stand disposed of.
CRL.M.(BAIL) 260/2026 3.

By way of the instant application, the applicant seeks extension of interim bail for a period of ten days in case arising out of FIR bearing no. 248/2025, registered at Police Station Palam Village,
Delhi, for the commission of offence punishable under Section 376 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 (hereafter 'IPC').
4.
Issue notice.
The learned APP accepts notice on behalf of the State.
5. The learned counsel appearing on behalf of the applicant argues that the interim bail of the application was earlier extended from 30.01.2025 till This is a digitally signed order.

However, due to a typographical error in the order sheet dated 21.01.2026, the date of release was wrongly mentioned as 30.02.2026 instead of 30.01.2026 and on account of the said typographical error, the applicant had moved another application before this Court on 30.01.2026,

sentences.text: It is stated that the applicant had furnished the bail bonds and was released from jail only in the evening of 02.02.2026, resulting in loss of crucial time granted by this Court for attending to the medical needs of his father.
Thus, it is prayed that the interim bail may be extended for a further period of ten days.
6. The learned APP for the State does not dispute the aforesaid factual position.

7. In view of the above, the interim bail granted to the applicant on 04.12.2025 is further extended for a period of one week from the date, on the same terms and conditions as granted vide order dated 04.12.2025.
8. Application stands disposed of in the above terms.
9. The order be uploaded on the website forthwith.
DR. SWARANA KANTA SHARMA, J FEBRUARY 05, 2026/
